official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Video Maker turns your ideas into short videos right in your ChatGPT conversation. Describe what the video should say, add photos if you like, and get an MP4 or GIF back to download. What it can make: - Promo and product videos with a headline, key points and a call to action. - Announcements, invitations, event countdowns and birthday or holiday greetings. - Explainers, lessons, tips and step-by-step lists. - Quote and motivational videos from your own words, one scene at a time. - Photo slideshows from up to 10 pictures, with captions, an opening title and a closing slide. Every video fits where it will be posted: vertical 9:16 for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and Stories, 16:9 for YouTube, square and 4:5 for feeds. Choose from 11 color themes or your own colors and gradients, five font styles, and fade, wipe or cut transitions, with text that appears line by line. It also edits videos you attach: trim, convert to MP4, WebM or GIF, make files smaller, change the shape, add captions, and take a still picture for a thumbnail. Privacy: files are processed on the AI Sciences Lab server only to do what you ask. New videos are kept behind a private download link for 60 minutes and then deleted automatically. File contents and file names are not logged. Limits: videos up to 120 seconds. Made videos have no sound and are not AI-generated footage: they are slides, photos and animated text. Text supports Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, Hebrew and Arabic letters; emoji are left out. Attached videos can be up to 100 MB. For pictures of scenes, people or objects, use ChatGPT's own image generation, then turn the pictures into a video here.
